questions.prompt: What does the async modifier allow in a method?
options: Run the method on a background thread
Use await to pause and resume
Make the method run in parallel
questions.explanation: async enables the await operator inside a method.
await unwraps Task<T> to its result T.
It avoids capturing the calling context, which is preferred in library code.

options: Waits for all tasks to finish
questions.explanation: It awaits every Task passed to it and completes when all finish.

questions.prompt: Complete the line to await and receive the value.
questions.explanation: await suspends until the Task finishes and yields its int result.

questions.prompt: ______ pauses the method until the Task finishes.
questions.template: ______ pauses the method until the Task finishes.
questions.explanation: await pauses the async method without blocking the thread.
